## ZGTA V

**2.0 beta · by zema**

Solo Story, Free Roam and Private Multiplayer.

**Requires iOS / iPadOS 15.0 or later**, compatible TrollStore / TrollStore Lite and your own prepared game files.

Install this package to install ZGTA V through your existing TrollStore setup. Update over the existing app. Removing this installer package leaves the app and its data installed.

### Installer 0.91-1 / App Build 91
- Fix opening archives found by a folder scan.

### Installer 0.90-1 / App Build 90
- Improve game-folder scanning and use English throughout the menus.

### Installer 0.88-2
- Fix TrollStore detection on RootHide.
